description: Defines a template class 'sequential_metrics_executor' that decorates a task executor to track performance metrics such as latency, with methods for executing and deferring tasks, and functions to create such executors with metrics tracking.

classes.name: sequential_metrics_executor
classes.description: A template class that decorates a task executor to track performance metrics such as latency, for sequential executors.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Attempts to execute a task, tracking metrics and managing task pool.

methods.name: defer
methods.description: Defers a task for later execution, tracking metrics.

methods.name: handle_metrics
methods.description: Updates and logs performance metrics, and reports periodically.
